races.paceDynamic: Blixen Force will lead uncontested from the gates with no other confirmed front runners in this field. New Yorker, Maria Quiteria, and What A Girl Wants will settle prominently behind the leader, creating a moderate early gallop over this minimum trip. Star Prospect and Velozee will drop out the back as hold-up horses, relying on late kicks. This sustainable early pace followed by tactical positioning battles favours prominent racers who can track the leader and strike decisively in the final furlong.

scenarios.title: Prominent Strike Home
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and Blixen Force maintains a steady gallop
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the perfect tow into contention before unleashing their finishing kicks. New Yorker and Maria Quiteria benefit most from this tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: Star Prospect and Velozee get clear runs from the back to exploit their superior finishing speed. The pace collapses late enough for their devastating kicks to be decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Escapes
scenarios.trigger: If Blixen Force gets an easy lead and finds extra improvement
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the field hesitates behind. Blixen Force holds on grimly as the closers charge too late over this sharp five furlongs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling slow with tactical maneuvering
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint from the two-furlong pole with traffic problems. Any horse finding clear room can capitalize on the bunched field and chaotic finish.

races.paceDynamic: Greek Mythology and Iron Lily will ensure a genuine pace from the outset, with both confirmed front runners likely to dispute the early lead. Causeway, Take Charge Star and Neolithic will sit prominently behind the leaders, while the hold-up horses Andab, Geryon and Redemption Road will need the pace to develop. With two willing pace-setters and several prominent racers, this should create an honest gallop that will test stamina reserves. This race shape clearly favours the prominent racers and closers who can sit off the early pace and benefit from the strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Greek Mythology and Iron Lily engage in a sustained battle from the start
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses and prominent racers with tactical speed. Andab and Geryon can use their closing kicks while Neolithic can improve from his handy position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If one pace-setter gets an easy lead while the other settles
scenarios.body: The winner will come from those who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the early fractions. Causeway and Neolithic are ideally positioned to capitalize on this scenario from their prominent styles.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Slow Burn Finish
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders settle into a more conservative rhythm early
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace will favour those with natural speed who can quicken decisively. Greek Mythology's finishing kick and Iron Lily's sustained front running could prove decisive in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too fast and both fade dramatically
scenarios.body: The race will become a pure test of who has the most left in the tank from the back. Redemption Road's hold-up style and Andab's proven finishing ability would benefit most from complete pace collapse.

races.paceDynamic: Edward Hamilton will lead from the gates with no other confirmed front runners to pressure him, allowing sustainable sectionals through the early stages. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can position handy and quicken, rather than pure front runners or horses needing significant pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.body: The pace collapse will suit horses positioned in the box seat, with Minnie Hauk and Beset perfectly placed to strike when the leader wilts. Their prominent style and class advantage over the hold-up horses becomes decisive in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is even more sedate than expected and Edward Hamilton stays on better than usual
scenarios.body: Cercene and Shaool will benefit from a truly-run race where their closing kick can be effective over this staying trip. The extra distance of 1m2f plays into their hands if they can pick up the pieces late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Edward Hamilton improves markedly on recent fade-in-finish form and finds reserves
scenarios.body: Despite his poor recent record when leading, the uncontested lead and good going could see him last home if others are caught flat-footed. His Aidan O'Brien stable form gives him an outside chance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Emerges

scenarios.body: A genuine gallop would completely change the complexion, allowing the hold-up horses to close strongly up the rail. Shaool's recent wins when getting pace to aim at would make him dangerous.

The prominent runners Pinar Del Rio, Carrigans Grove, Comfort Line and Summer Island will settle just behind, but none are aggressive gate-speed types to challenge Free Solo's lead. This creates a moderate pace scenario where Free Solo can control fractions, with the large field of hold-up horses including Loingseoir, Go Out, Moyassr and Methgal tracking from midfield and rear. The tactical verdict clearly favours prominent runners and those that can position handily, as they'll have first run on a likely bunched field of hold-up horses when the pace lifts.
